claims.claim: Natality is conceptualized as a capacity for beginning and acting that is part of the human condition, serving as an inherent potential for freedom and new beginnings rather than being determined by external forces.
claims.supporting_excerpt: »زادﮔﯽ«  ﻗﺪرﺗﯽ ﺑﺮاي آﻏﺎزﯾﺪن و ﻋﻤﻞ ﮐﺮدن اﺳﺖ ﮐﻪ ﺑﺨﺸـﯽ از وﺿـﻊ   ، ﮐﻨﺪ ﯾﺎد ﻣﯽ ﻫـﺎﯾﯽ   ﻗـﺪرت ﻪ وﺳـﯿﻠ  ﺳﺖ ﮐﻪ ﻇﺮﻓﯿﺖ ﻣﺎ ﻫﺮﮔﺰ ﺻﺮﻓﺎً ﺑﻪاﯾﻦ ﺑﺪﯾﻦ ﻣﻌﻨﺎ. ﺷﻮد ﺸﺮ ﻣﺤﺴﻮب ﻣﯽﺑ ﮕﯽ و از ﺧﻮدﺑﯿﮕـﺎﻧ ﻫﻤﭽـﻮن   ﻣﺎﻧﻨـﺪ ﻃﺒﯿﻌـﺖ و ﺗـﺎرﯾﺦ و ﯾـﺎ از ﭼﯿـﺰي درون ﻣـﺎ      ، ﺑﯿﺮون از ﻣﺎ ﺑﻠﮑﻪ ﻣﺎ ﺑﺎ ﻇﺮﻓﯿﺖ و اﺳﺘﻌﺪادي ﺑﺮاي آزادي و ﺑﺎ ﺗﻮاﻧﺎﯾﯽ آﻏﺎز ﮐﺮدن ؛ ﺷﻮد ﺗﻌﯿﯿﻦ ﻧﻤﯽ ﺎاﻣﯿﺪيﻧ

definitions.definition: Loss of the world and of stable enduring institutions and political speech and action that support human plurality and a place of residence distinct from nature.
The capacity and power to begin and act, constituting a part of the human condition and providing the potential for freedom and generating new things.

distinctions.distinction: Arendt refers to ancient Greek antiquity and phenomenological approaches to explain the distinction and recover the public sphere as a space of freedom.

must_not_be_lost: Arendt's phenomenological and deconstructive reading of philosophical tradition derived from Heidegger and Augustine.
